channel.title: Wire — Frontend
channel.description: Frontend from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: The Process of Migrating from Sass to Native CSS
item.description: I took the decision to replace all our Sass with native CSS as I could see some benefits. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: CSS Navigation Matching, Early Days
item.description: Apply a style when someone navigates from one specific page to another. The idea being it'd make the sources for cross-document view transitions declarative in CSS rather than managing that stuff in JavaScript. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: 3D CSS, from Super Mario Bros 3 to Mario 64
item.description: A beginner's guide to 3D transforms in CSS: perspective, perspective-origin, preserve-3d, translateZ and rotateX/Y/Z, explained with live demos. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Inaudible Sounds Used to Fingerprint Browsers Catch AliExpress Red-Handed
item.description: Is the technique outdated? Yes. Is it still creepy? Also yes. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Where Did the Old Web Go? We Followed 657,607 Links to Find Out
item.description: A complete crawl of every restored 0.mk link from 2009 to 2014 found that 76.7% no longer return a loading page. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: The Three AI Tools That Actually Matter for Building Mobile Apps
item.description: Skip the AI tooling noise. Skills, MCPs, and the right AI workflow are the three things that get an AI to ship beautiful, performant mobile apps. (1 source: frontendfocus)
